svg.text: Recovery Workbench · build calendar, November 2026 to June 2027
31 epics (7 platform, 19 service, 5 integration), 1032 open stories. One bar = one work package = one epic for one monthly release; the number on the bar is its story count.

text.tspan: RWB = Recovery Workbench · SVC = service epic · P1 = module 1 (rwb-source-data)
platform modules: shared capabilities used by every stage (data, case, access, documents...)
stage modules: one recovery stage each (valuation, treatment, guarantee, litigation...)
platform epics: TPL template, LIB libraries, WF workflow kit, DB, EVT events, EDGE, OBS
integration epics per delivery wave, plus ITG-NFR (load, resilience)
story: module P1 · legacy key RWB-E1-064 · work type
work types: CON contract · DB · INF infra · OPS · APP code · ITG integration test
Each module = 1 service: own schema rwb_<name>, REST base, Kafka topic, Temporal queue

svg.text: Adding a stream later (for example in January for February and March)
1. Hand over whole bars only: one epic for one month, never part of one.
2. Take a cluster (C1 to C6) or one month column of a cluster; both are self-contained.
3. Each service's contract is published with a fake before its build (gate G7),
so the new stream builds against fakes and waits for no one.
4. Separate code, schema, topic and queue per service: no merge conflicts across streams.
5. Platform (C0) and integration (C7) bars can also be handed over whole.
Example: a stream joining mid-January takes C5 (S2, S5, S4) for February and March from Stream A.
November 2026 (Q4 sprints 1 and 2) · 27 new-ID stories open
RWB-TE-001 module folder + boundary test → PLT-TPL (2 stories)
RWB-E1-001 recovery tables (Dev In Progress) → P1, P4, P7, P8, ITG-W1
RWB-E1-064 data dictionary → P1, P4, ITG-W1
RWB-TE-003 contract tests from the API spec → PLT-TPL
28 Feb · Settle, deed in lieu, assets
shared; template, libraries and workflow kit first · 63 stories
◂ 7 Dec: service builds start on template + libraries
integration build at the end of each window, then SIT and UAT · 147 stories
61 · Full administration (flag off until the June release)
of which Stream A (C1, C2, C5)
of which Stream B (C3, C4, C6)
of which shared (C0 platform, C7 integration; Stream B leads C0 in Dec)

Sources: Jira export (November sprint status), Realignment Tracker v4 (1,034 stories by epic and business epic; 2 done stories excluded), Ownership Map v1, Release Plan v5 (scope, month-end dates, tentative). Story counts follow each story's business epic (EP01-EP08) mapped to a monthly release. Decision D-RCV-60.
